**Egypt: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,220,532 applications. The largest annual volume was 437,229 in 2024; 2025 recorded 292,686. Applications in 2025 were 1,054% higher than in 2019 (25,359). In 2025, 55,619 recorded decisions equated to 19 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 33% lower than in 2024 (437,229). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 5 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Sudan (264,846), South Sudan (10,152), Eritrea (8,439).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 97%, across 17,024 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 69% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 9.8 percentage points higher than in 2024 (87%).
